heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: dGf 257 kJ/mol (1.33 V) at 25 C; 189 kJ/mol (0.97 V) at 800 C
evidence_excerpt_or_description: At 25 C, dGf is 257 kJ/mol, which corresponds to a reversible voltage of 1.33 V. At 800 C, dGf is only 189 kJ/mol or 0.97 V
notes: dGf = 90% of dHf at 25 C, 67% at 800 C; Nernst Eq. 3 on same page

heading: Performance indicators
reported_value: Joule heat used in high-temperature cells; thermoneutral operation balances heat demand
evidence_excerpt_or_description: Joule heat ... can be utilized in high-temperature electrolysis cells ... When a high-temperature electrolysis cell is operated at thermoneutral voltage, the heat demand for the electrolysis process matches exactly the heat produced via Joule heating
notes: below thermoneutral, heat must be supplied (not quantified)

heading: Reactor configuration
reported_value: 700-900 C; O2 formed at the anode; product free of H2 and H2O with pure CO2 feed
evidence_excerpt_or_description: as long as pure CO2 (or a mixture of CO and CO2) is fed to the fuel electrode, the formed product will be free of H2 and H2O
notes: O2 leaves on the anode side: CO and O2 separated in the cell; 700-900 C stated on PDF p. 3

heading: Operating conditions
reported_value: SOEC approaching TRL 8; durability over a year on stream
evidence_excerpt_or_description: high-temperature electrolysis in solid oxide cells is the only CO2 electrolysis technology that is approaching commercialization (TRL 8) and for which long-term durability exceeding a year on stream has been demonstrated
notes: the 7600 h test (E016) is shorter than a year; source of the >1 year claim not given
